comments.detroitlion: Lightly raced 4yo who was second at Southwell (AW) last month and could be in the mix
comments.greenlightforgo: Soundly beaten on final two runs last year to make it 0-8; needs to raise his game
comments.letmeseethecolts: Consistent filly who was runner-up in big field at Doncaster recently; solid contender
comments.mrzippi: Well treated on form as recent as December but three lesser runs have followed
comments.ribbleriver: Won his final two starts last season and this unexposed 4yo could continue to improve
comments.sonning: Below par at end of last season but makes stable debut off a handy mark
comments.trapperjohn: Down the field on all 4 starts, but may have needed handicap debut run; check the market
comments.valueadded: Well beaten on AW on both runs for this yard and has plenty to prove
comments.vampireslayer: Ran fairly well over hurdles in February; runner-up on last two Flat outings last spring

verdict.comment: Useful hurdler PIGEON HOUSE was a close second back on the Flat at Musselburgh last week and is the pick ahead of Glory And Honour.

comments.bamboobay: Won at Redcar last September but faces tough task from 11lb out of the handicap
comments.diamanddevindecy: Disappointing end to last year but below his last winning mark and is back in cheekpieces
comments.gloryandhonour: Ran well over fences two starts ago and he won over C&D last October; could have big say
comments.goldenflame: On a reduced mark and has shown some spark this year, but his losing run continues
comments.justus: Tailed off over C&D last October and absent since, but he won this last year
comments.pigeonhouse: Useful hurdler who was a good second back on the Flat last week and is a key player
comments.royaldeeside: Hasn't shone in various disciplines of late and others are preferred

races.raceComment: gloryandhonour is marginally preferred with a score of 57.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more progressive over justus. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 7 wins from 36 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Four-time C&D winner VENTURA EXPRESS (nap) reappeared with a promising second at Newcastle and has the benefit of the rail draw.

comments.alzahir: Won at Doncaster recently and remains well treated under a penalty, but that was over 7f
comments.brooklynninenine: Mixed form since December AW win; needs something extra with blinkers replacing ch'pieces
comments.dreamcomposer: Below par on final two runs last season but won over C&D previously; 2-5 here; considered
comments.fahrenheitseven: Lightly raced 4yo; three wins last year and reappeared with good third on AW; drawn well
comments.intervention: Poor turf strike-rate and recent AW win came over 7f, but he's not ruled out
comments.manilascouse: Disappointing end to last season but has a good reappearance record; not ruled out
comments.nazron: Won last August but well beaten the last twice; returns from a break and wind surgery
comments.venturaexpress: Four-time C&D winner who reappeared with close 2nd at Newcastle last month; lots to like
comments.venturecapital: Suited by the drop back to 5f last autumn and he could have more to offer this term

verdict.comment: The return to turf could be a positive for WRESTLING REVENUE who is taken to exploit a handy mark. South Shore is a danger.

comments.crocodilepower: Three wins at Catterick last August-October and can also be effective elsewhere; chance
comments.doddiesimpact: Fair third at Newcastle last time and he's not ruled out now back on turf
comments.herakles: Won off 2lb higher mark last June and could show the benefit of last month's comeback run
comments.ifonlytheycudtalk: Knocking at the door prior to winning at Beverley last September; makes reappearance
comments.kingscrown: Two AW wins this year but below par the last twice and needs to bounce back
comments.mrstrump: Three wins last term and signed off with good third here last October; possible player
comments.onemoredream: Won at Wolverhampton in February but he's 9-38 on AW as opposed to just 1-16 on grass
comments.southshore: Encouraging signs off reduced mark on AW recently; major player if backing that up
comments.torfrida: Down the field on both runs in 2024 but good form of yard means she's worth a second look
comments.wrestlingrevenue: Yet to shine for current yard but he's on an attractive mark now back on turf

races.raceComment: mrstrump is marginally preferred with a score of 50.3%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive over crocodilepower. verdict.comment: Improving mare IMPERIAL JADE should be very much at home on this galloping track and she can bring up the hat-trick.

comments.cityderby: Had gone off the boil when last seen and this isn't really his sort of track
comments.hourless: Struggles continued when only sixth of the eight runners at Hexham two weeks ago
comments.imperialjade: Has won her last two; very much a galloper so Carlisle should be up her street
comments.mryeats: May need further but he makes debut for a respected new yard off an attractive mark
comments.thenavigator: Tailed off the last twice following a break; it was a Class 2 the last time
comments.willaston: In good nick about this time two years ago but hasn't approached that level this season

races.raceComment: imperialjade is marginally preferred with a score of 53.0%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over thenavigator. Won 2 of last 6 starts. comments.prettyspirited: Beat one home in three starts last year; makes handicap/AW debut.
